title: P0: demo entry transition (enter_demo) has zero dispatch-level coverage - the claimed deep-link pin starts from a hand-built demo model
evidence: client.gleam:488 'routes.Demo, False -> enter_demo(model, route)' and init boot 236-239 'let #(demo_model, demo_eff) = enter_demo(base_model, route)'; the r4 pin demo_deep_link_boot_state_test instead constructs the post-entry state by hand: 'demo_mode: True, demo_store: Some(store), auth: Success(demo_store.landlord(store)), vacancies: NotAsked, vacancy_detail_request_id: Some("v-maples")'. No test in client/test/demo/ or client_test.gleam dispatches BrowserChangedUrl(/demo) from a non-demo model.
detail: enter_demo's seeding (request ids, edit id, Loading-vs-NotAsked split, seed-Error fallback) can regress green - the exact r2-B2/B4 and r3-B1 boot-bug class. Critical-path happy AND error arms unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a dispatch test: client.update(non-demo model, BrowserChangedUrl(/demo uri)) asserting demo_mode, auth, request ids, vacancies Loading; plus a deep-link variant for VacancyDetail(v-maples).

title: mark-opened store-threading and the read/refetch demo branches in client.gleam remain unpinned (r2-B5 regression class)
location: client/src/client.gleam:2544-2578 (mark-opened threading), 1992 (scoring status), 2339/2394 (awaiting), 4216/4969 (leaderboard refresh), 4349 (bell notifications), 6997/7314 (detail refetch)
evidence: 2544-2553: '// demo: the store idempotently moves Submitted -> UnderReview - thread the mutated store back into the model ... let #(updated, eff) = case dispatch, model.demo_mode { True, True -> { let #(next, demo_eff) = demo_api.mark_application_opened('. grep of client/test/demo/demo_flow_test.gleam for mark_application_opened/ApiReturnedApplicationOpened/fetch_awaiting/scoring_status/LeaderboardRefresh returns nothing.
detail: The r4 pins cover close/archive/restore/status-change/mark-read, but mark-opened's demo_store: Some(next) threading and seven read/refetch demo branches can be reverted to 'let _ = next' or the real api and the suite stays green.
recommended_fix: One dispatch pin per remaining demo branch: mark-opened asserts store status transition; awaiting/scoring-status/bell/leaderboard-refresh assert the demo arm ran (Loading/store data), not the real api.

title: New defensive demo guards unpinned: crafted ?payment=success / ?extended=success drops and the ApiReturnedSession demo no-op
evidence: 5507: 'Ok(#(_, "success")) if updated_model.demo_mode -> #(' ; 1022-1026: '// Demo mode never dispatches check_session (entry seeds auth directly); // a stray response (defensive) must not trigger real route fetches. case model.demo_mode { True -> #(model, effect.none())'. Tests cover only the real-mode payment path (client_test.gleam:151 payment_success_query_dispatches_toast_and_polling_test).
detail: These guards are the no-network pillar's crafted-URL defence; deleting the demo guard re-enables payment polling/pixel in demo with no test failing.
recommended_fix: Dispatch-level pins: demo model + BrowserChangedUrl with ?payment=success / ?extended=success asserts no payment_polling and no toast; ApiReturnedSession(Ok(...)) in demo_mode asserts model unchanged.

title: New demo branches in fire_refcheck_slot_action / fire_refcheck_call_action / save_refcheck_edit are unreachable - demo_update intercepts all three message paths
evidence: demo_update.gleam:476-481 'UserChoseRefcheckAction(call_id, action) -> ... RefcheckSkip -> fire_demo_refcheck(model, call_id, "skip") RefcheckReEnable -> fire_demo_refcheck(model, call_id, "re_enable")' and 496 'UserSavedRefcheckEdit(call_id) ->' intercept before fallback; client.gleam:7355-7358 'case model.demo_mode { True -> { let wire_action = case action { "re_enable" -> "re-enable"' can therefore never run (real callers at 2873 pass "re-enable" already).

title: still present since round 3: entering demo clobbers a live landlord session; exit downgrades auth to NotAsked
evidence: enter_demo: 'Model(..model, route:, auth: Success(landlord), csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token", demo_mode: True,' - overwrites any existing Success(real landlord) unconditionally; clear_demo_state (model.gleam:752): 'auth: NotAsked,'.
detail: Verified unchanged at this sha: a logged-in landlord opening /demo loses SPA auth state and exits to NotAsked, forcing a client-side re-auth despite an intact session cookie.
recommended_fix: Stash the pre-demo auth in the model on entry and restore it in clear_demo_state (or re-check session on exit).

title: still present since round 3: demo exit from a dirty edit page clears demo state before the unsaved-changes guard fires
evidence: '_, True -> case is_public_route(route) { True -> handle_browser_change(model |> model.clear_demo_state, uri, route)' - clear runs first; the guard inside handle_browser_change then reads the stale flag: 'case model.vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes { True -> #( Model(..updated_model, route: model.route, show_unsaved_changes_prompt: True,'. clear_demo_state does not clear vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes.
detail: Verified unchanged: exiting demo from a dirty demo edit prompts against the already-cleared state and URL-replaces back to /vacancies/<fixture-id>/edit; 'keep editing' lands on a real fetch for a fixture id.
recommended_fix: Run the dirty-edit guard before clear_demo_state, or skip the prompt when the destination is a public (demo-exiting) route.

title: still present since round 3 (partially fixed): enter_demo replicates the navigation model reset but never uninstalls an installed consent-modal focus trap
evidence: enter_demo resets 'unlock_consent_modal_open: None, unlock_consent_checked: False, unlock_consent_submitting: False,' (and extension equivalents) but its only effect is demo_entry_effects; handle_browser_change carries the trap teardown enter_demo lacks: 'let eff = case any_consent_modal_open { True -> effect.batch([eff, effect.from(fn(_dispatch) { policy_reaccept_modal_focus.uninstall() })])'.
detail: Dropdowns/confirms/modal state now reset (that part of the r3 fix landed), but navigating to /demo with a consent modal open leaves the focus-trap singleton installed on the demo page.
recommended_fix: Fire policy_reaccept_modal_focus.uninstall() in enter_demo when either consent modal was open, mirroring handle_browser_change.

title: still present since round 3: deep-link demo boots fire only demo_entry - per-surface analytics undercount the primary shared-URL path
evidence: demo_entry_effects: 'let base = [demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ApiReturnedNotifications)] let route_eff = case route { routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard -> [demo_api.list_vacancies(store, ApiReturnedDashboardData)]' - no capture_event anywhere in the function; only enter_demo (5784) fires demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_entry).
detail: Verified unchanged: a fresh boot into /vacancies/v-maples counts demo_entry but not demo_vacancy_open, while the identical in-session navigation counts both.
recommended_fix: Fire the matching surface event in each demo_entry_effects route arm (vacancy open, application open, archived open, comparison open).

title: still present since round 3: comparison deep link passes persisted real localStorage ids into the demo store
evidence: routes.Comparison arm of demo_entry_effects: 'demo_api.fetch_comparison( store, vid, load_comparison_ids(), ApiReturnedComparisonDetails, )' - unconditional, no empty-ids guard (the navigation path at 5425-5427 guards: '[] -> #(updated_model, eff)').

recommended_fix: Mirror the navigation path's empty-ids guard in the Comparison arm and prefer fixture comparison ids in demo.

title: still present since round 3: failed demo seed desyncs model.route from the browser URL
evidence: enter_demo Error arm: 'Error(_) -> #( Model(..model, route: routes.Landing, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None), effect.none(), )' - no modem.replace, so the address bar keeps /demo while Landing renders.

title: still present since round 3: edit deep-link boot renders the empty form for the first frame - enter_demo never sets vacancy_edit_loading

title: still present since round 3: in-demo navigation writes demo comparison ids to the real product's localStorage

title: still present since round 3: latent policy re-acceptance modal can surface in demo and fire a real accept_policy POST
